We stopped doing sprint retros in March.

Not because they were bad. Because nobody could remember a single thing we changed after one.

I went back through eight months of notes. 41 action items. Three shipped. One of the three was "buy a second whiteboard."

So now we do one thing: when something breaks, the person who found it writes two sentences in a channel called #it-happened. What broke, what we did.

Nobody has to attend. Nobody has to facilitate. Nobody has to pretend the sticky notes were worth it.

Forty-one action items in eight months. The channel has had nineteen entries in six weeks, and I can tell you what every one of them changed.

Turns out the retro was never the point. The receipt was.

Notes here: https://example.com/it-happened
